progress_definition: Completed gates / 12, rounded to integer; NOT success probability or security coverage. Documentation review = six explicit desk-review gates. Two regression gates require fresh passing test proof.

sites.name: Minnit
sites.scope: One authorized room/channel; documented message events and send specification

gates.label: Scope and permitted integration route
gates.evidence: Documented owned/authorized room integration; no stranger outreach

gates.label: Authentication and entitlement review
gates.evidence: Organization endpoint + X-Key; API Basic+, custom webhooks Community+. Secret kept server-side.

gates.label: Guest/provisioned user flow review
gates.evidence: Guests talk/view by default unless owner restricts; disposable guest ID is not provider account signup.

gates.label: Inbound contract design
gates.evidence: chat_message -> data[] with msg_id/chat_id/channel/user_id/message. Edits remain a separate kind. Local fixture cap: 100 events.

gates.label: Outbound contract design
gates.evidence: POST action=sendmessage, chatname/channel/username/message, form encoding. Endpoint must come from organization dashboard.

gates.label: Lifecycle and failure plan
gates.evidence: Normalize -> instance/room scope -> ID dedup -> explicit user action -> guarded submission -> accepted/failed/unknown; stop invalidates run

gates.label: Offline parser/specification regression suite
gates.evidence: Completion derives from passing test receipt matching current source

gates.label: Offline malformed/scope/privacy/outcome regression suite
gates.evidence: Completion derives from passing test receipt matching current source

gates.label: Provider-compatible inbound authenticity/replay verification
gates.evidence: No signature format assumed; confirm supported secret/signature and replay protection

gates.label: Authorized room, credentials and required plan
gates.evidence: No room/account/secret configured; no purchase approved

gates.label: Authenticated staging integration
gates.evidence: Real adapter receiver/sender is not implemented or live-tested

sites.name: DeadSimpleChat
sites.scope: One authorized room; documented button-action event and bot send specification

gates.label: Scope and permitted integration route
gates.evidence: Documented owned/authorized room integration; no stranger outreach

gates.label: Authentication and entitlement review
gates.evidence: Advanced API Business plan; private key in auth query. Docs examples also show Authorization header without clearly resolving whether it is additional. Verify in staging.

gates.label: Guest/provisioned user flow review
gates.evidence: Public-room nickname join provisions guest_ identity; provisioned/members-only modes differ. Customer managed-user API is not provider signup.

gates.label: Inbound contract design
gates.evidence: Verified documentation shape here is actionButtonPressed with chatRoom/user/actionButtonPressed. Enclosing message is the bot question, not user text. Ordinary message trigger normalization is not guessed.

gates.label: Outbound contract design
gates.evidence: POST /consumer/api/v2/bot/:botId/chatroom/:roomId/message; JSON message <=1000; documented 200 success:true means API accepted only.
